va.scripts.title: Call Scripts
va.scripts.greetingText: Hi, this is [Your Name] from Brandaro. I'm reaching out because we help businesses like yours grow their online presence. Do you have a quick moment?
va.scripts.qualifyText: Great! Can you tell me a bit about your current marketing setup? Do you have a website, social media, or Google Business profile?
va.scripts.pitchText: We specialize in helping local businesses dominate their market online. Our clients typically see 3-5x more customer inquiries within the first 90 days.
va.scripts.closeText: I'd love to set up a quick 15-minute demo to show you exactly how this would work for your business. What day works best for you this week?
va.rebuttals.title: Objection Handling
va.rebuttals.tooExpensiveResponse: I completely understand budget concerns. What we find is that our service actually pays for itself within the first month through increased customer leads. Would it help if I showed you a ROI projection specific to your business?
va.rebuttals.notInterestedResponse: I appreciate your honesty. Many of our most successful clients felt the same way initially. Could I ask what's working for you currently in terms of getting new customers?
va.rebuttals.callBackResponse: Absolutely, I respect your time. When would be a good time to reconnect? I'll make sure to have some specific data about businesses in your area ready for our conversation.
va.rebuttals.alreadyHaveResponse: That's great you're investing in marketing! We often work alongside existing providers. Would you be open to a free audit to see if there are areas being missed?
va.faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
va.faqs.a1: Brandaro offers full-service digital marketing including website design, SEO, Google Ads management, social media marketing, reputation management, and lead generation.
va.faqs.a2: Our packages start at $497/month. The exact pricing depends on the services needed. We offer a free consultation to assess your needs and provide a custom quote.
va.faqs.q3: How long before I see results?
va.faqs.a3: Most clients see initial results within 30-60 days. Full campaign optimization typically takes 90 days for maximum performance.
va.faqs.a4: We offer month-to-month plans with no long-term contracts. We believe in earning your business every month through results.
va.faqs.a5: We combine AI-powered lead generation with dedicated human account management. Our clients get more leads at a lower cost than traditional agencies.
